brief:
The Palestinian Prisoners' Club said the physical condition of detained journalist Muhammad Arab during his court hearing Sunday exemplifies the systematic suffering of thousands of Palestinian prisoners subjected to torture and mistreatment in Israeli detention facilities, Shehab Wire reported. Arab appeared before the court as his trial proceeded on the day in question.

The prisoners' group issued a statement after observing the journalist's appearance, using his case to spotlight broader allegations of abuse within the Israeli prison system. The club characterized Arab's visible condition as a reflection of what detainees across the facilities endure. Prison rights advocates have long documented claims of torture and ill-treatment in Israeli jails.
